speaker: Samantha
text: Why do we travel? I don’t mind the actual flying, the wonder of being airborne in a dense metal bird. The rest of the journey, however, can feel like a tedious lesson in the ills of modernity, from the predawn x-ray screening to the sad airport malls selling clusters of keepsakes. It’s the result of a globalized world, and it sucks.
